request:
I run a small provisions shop in Madina and I want to keep my price list on the computer instead of in my notebook. I want to add the things I sell with their prices. I want to see everything I sell, and look up the price of one thing. Sometimes I stop selling something, so I want to take it off the list.

The client's answers to your questions:
Q: When a price goes up or down, do you want to be able to change the price of an item that is already on the list?
A: Yes, prices change all the time, especially sugar, rice and oil. I need to change the price of an item.
Q: Do you sell the same thing in different sizes or amounts at different prices, like one sachet versus a whole pack? If so, should each size have its own price?
A: No preference: you decide.
Q: When you look up a price, will you type the full name of the item, or should it also find items when you type only part of the name, like 'milk' finding 'Peak Milk'?
A: No preference: you decide.

Where the client has no preference or did not answer, choose the simplest option and add nothing they did not ask for (no logins, PINs or extra required fields).
summary:
Your price list program is written and all 6 of its tests pass. Your items and prices are saved in a file called `shop.db` in the same folder, so they stay there after you close the program.

**What you can do** (each item gets its own number, its "id"):
- **Add an item:** `POST /items` with a name and price, e.g. `{"name": "Sugar", "price": 12.5}`. It sends back the item with its number.
- **See everything you sell:** `GET /items` lists all items, sorted by name.
- **Look up one item's price:** `GET /items/{id}`.
- **Change a price:** `PATCH /items/{id}` with the new price, e.g. `{"price": 14}`.
- **Take an item off the list:** `DELETE /items/{id}`.

**What it refuses:**
- An item with no name.
- A price of zero or less, or no price at all.
- An item whose name is already on the list (capital letters don't matter, so "peak milk" counts as "Peak Milk").
- Looking up, changing or removing an item number that doesn't exist.

**Choices I made where you had no preference:**
- **Different sizes:** each size is just its own item, like "Milo sachet" and "Milo tin".
- **Looking up a price:** you look up an item by its number, not by typing its name. To find a number, open the full list. Searching by part of a name (like "milk" finding "Peak Milk") isn't included. It can be added later if you want it.
